question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select "No error’. 

I thanked him, / staring at him far beyond the bounds of good manners, / and holding tight to Joe.

options.text: staring at him far beyond the bounds of good manners,

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the phrase "**staring at him far beyond the bounds of good manners**".
 
• The phrase is awkward and unclear, and it would be better to rephrase it to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**staring at him for far longer than good manners allow**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I thanked him, **staring at him for far longer than good manners allow, and holding tight to Joe.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
 
• **and holding tight to Joe.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **I thanked him,** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
